title: RSSHub
name: rsshub
description: RSS feed maker for thousands of sites that don't have a feed of their own, like GitHub issues, news sites, forums and shops. Source: https://github.com/DIYgod/RSSHub

env.name: ACCESS_KEY
env.label: Access key
env.description: Optional. Set one and every feed url needs it, like /hackernews?key=yourkey. Leave blank and anyone who can reach it can use it.

note: Open http://<your-host>:1200 to check it's up, then add feeds to your reader as paths on it, like /github/issue/DIYgod/RSSHub. Every route is listed in the docs. There's no login, so set an access key if it faces the internet. Nothing to back up, feeds are cached in memory. Some routes need a browser, and for those swap the image tag to chromium-bundled.
